name: assess-holistic-health
description: Conduct temperament-based health assessment from Hildegard von Bingen's Causae et Curae. Evaluates the four temperaments (sanguine, choleric, melancholic, phlegmatic), elemental correspondences (air, fire, earth, water), and provides dietary and lifestyle recommendations for rebalancing. Use when understanding constitutional type in Hildegardian terms, experiencing imbalance (fatigue, digestive issues, mental fog) needing holistic guidance, seeking dietary recommendations by temperament, or researching medieval humoral medicine.
